name: Venue name
status: What has actually happened so far (interest, meeting, walkthrough). Never record a proposal as an agreement.
notes: Copy this file to venues/<venue-slug>/finance-inputs.json, fill in what you know, then run: python3 finance/model.py
Labels: confirmed (venue said so in writing or on the record), quote (written price), assumption (our guess), open (unknown, placeholder).
Delete an input to fall back to the model default; the report marks those as '(model default)'.

lp_share.label: open
lp_share.note: Lucky Pigeon share after fees, refunds and chargebacks

venue_minimum_per_month.label: open
venue_minimum_per_month.note: Guaranteed monthly minimum to the venue

electricity_per_month.label: open
electricity_per_month.note: Paid by Lucky Pigeon; 0 if the venue covers it

machine_slots.label: open
machine_slots.note: Machines the space can hold, with room to play

moving_per_machine.label: open
moving_per_machine.note: Per move; stairs or tight doors raise it

cashless_share.label: assumption
cashless_share.note: Share of play paid by card/phone

games_per_machine_week.label: open
games_per_machine_week.note: Paid games per machine per week; base on traffic data and observation

price_per_game.label: assumption
price_per_game.note: Blended price; family crowds buying 3 for $2 pull toward $0.67
